title: OCOO-T : A Simple and Scalable Virtual Cell Model for Transcriptional Perturbation Response Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2606.12838v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predicting single-cell transcriptional responses to genetic, chemical and cytokine perturbations is a fundamental challenge in computational biology and AI Virtual Cell (AIVC) modeling, with direct implications for drug discovery and the elucidation of gene regulatory networks. Existing approaches often rely on auxiliary cell-state encoders, hierarchical variational autoencoders, dedicated Transformer encoder-decoder modules, or gene-interaction priors to compress high-dimensional expression profiles into latent representations. While effective, these designs increase architectural complexity and may limit scalability and generalizability. This paper introduces OCOO-T, a minimalist flow-matching-based AIVC model for transcriptional perturbation response prediction. translated_title: OCOO-T：一种用于转录扰动响应预测的简单且可扩展的虚拟细胞模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.12838v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：预测单细胞对遗传、化学和细胞因子扰动的转录响应是计算生物学和AI虚拟细胞（AIVC）建模中的一个基本挑战，对药物发现和基因调控网络的阐明具有直接影响。现有方法通常依赖辅助细胞状态编码器、层次变分自编码器、专用Transformer编码器-解码器模块或基因相互作用先验，将高维表达谱压缩为潜在表示。虽然这些方法有效，但增加了架构复杂性，并可能限制可扩展性和泛化性。本文介绍了OCOO-T，一种基于流匹配的极简AIVC模型，用于转录扰动响应预测。OCOO-T利用一个直接操作于连续基因表达谱的普通Transformer堆栈，并将扰动响应预测表述为一个连续过程。
tldr: OCOO-T提出了一种极简的基于流匹配的虚拟细胞模型，仅用普通Transformer处理连续基因表达，简化架构并提升可扩展性，用于高效预测转录扰动响应。
en_tdlr: OCOO-T introduces a minimalist flow-matching-based virtual cell model that uses a vanilla Transformer on continuous gene expression profiles, simplifying architecture and enhancing scalability for efficient transcriptional perturbation response prediction.
